Grade mismatch is the hidden constraint. The 70% non-Hormuz headline covers volume, not quality. Indian refineries configured for heavy-sour Gulf crude cannot absorb light-sweet Russian/African alternatives without yield penalties. LPG remains 70% Gulf-dependent even after emergency action — a household-level exposure the crude headline obscures.
